text:
zhou: Customer reported duplicate DB writes after a short 429 + token-rotate burst. They were running our Python sample in serverless workers.
kim: Were they setting Idempotency-Key?
zhou: They thought so, but the serverless helper path in the sample strips headers on retries (body re-construct) so the header got lost on the second attempt.
rahul: Oof. Two simultaneous problems: header stripping in retry middleware + immediate retry during refresh.
zhou: Trace: initial request -> 429 -> auto-retry starts -> auth rotate happens -> retry without header accepted. Two writes ~220ms apart.
sdk-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-5012: "serverless retry middleware header preservation + refresh debounce"
kim: For parity: Node/Go SDKs preserve headers on retry for serverless helpers; Python sample didn't. We should patch sample and add a unit that replays headers.
ivy: Short mitigation to send to customer: 1) enable server-side dedupe on Idempotency-Key 2) temporarily disable aggressive immediate retries in their serverless config 3) upgrade once patch lands.
rahul: Proposed quick fix in sample (Python): wrap retry to copy headers into the perf payload and attach a generated Idempotency-Key if missing. Also add a tiny sleep when refresh in flight: sleep(random(100,300)).
kim: Can we instead add a small SDK-level refresh mutex so retries wait for refresh to finish rather than racing? Opt-in flag safe_replay = True?
zhou: I like safe_replay as opt-in. Default off so low-risk apps keep latency. Document tradeoffs.
sdk-bot: PRs opened: python-samples#215, node-sdk#623 (parity check), go-sdk#440. CI queued.
ivy: Telemetry ask: emit metric sdk.retry_header_lost and sdk.retry_during_refresh. Console owners can alert on increased counts.
rahul: Also add an assert in dev-mode sample: if side-effect POST and no Idempotency-Key -> warn or fail. That will catch this during onboarding.
kim: For the immediate customer message, include a minimal code snippet they can drop-in (Python):
```py
# naive guard
refreshing = False
async def send_safe(req):
    if refreshing:
        await asyncio.sleep(random.uniform(0.12, 0.28))
    resp = await send_with_preserved_headers(req)
    if resp.status == 429:
        return await jittered_backoff_retry(req)
    return resp
async def refresh_token():
    global refreshing
    refreshing = True
    await do_refresh()
    refreshing = False
```
zhou: I'll draft the customer note and link PRs. Kim, can you own the Python sample patch? Rahul takes telemetry + dev-mode assert?
kim: I can do Python sample today.
rahul: On telemetry and docs. Adding alert playbook to Console runbooks.
ivy: Thanks team. Let's ship the sample patch and a short doc note in the onboarding checklist: "server-side idempotency + SDK parity for serverless helpers".
sdk-bot: Incident log dup-write-2027-01-18 created.
zhou: Great. I'll follow up with the customer after PR merge. :thumbsup:
